limits: Local same-integer-input contrast uses folded FP32 weight and bias, so it is total local quantization error rather than isolated scale error.
Weights-only contrast keeps FP32 bias and cumulative activations; it cannot be subtracted to form an orthogonal error decomposition.
Injection uses full floating-path tensors and repairs upstream plus local discrepancy; it is an ideal-tensor intervention, not per-layer causal attribution.
All three injected tensors affect S16 only; this does not locate S4/S8 causality or establish AP recovery.
Per-frame mean NRMSE and pooled reference-energy NRMSE differ; local ranking changes with aggregation.
Uniform half-scale is a one-shot mechanism proposal; calibration-component FP extrema exceed the new range by construction and must be audited.

supplemental_root_recalculation.method: For a fixed head shape per frame, pooled_NRMSE=sqrt(sum(rmse^2)/sum((rmse/nrmse)^2)); all included head errors nonzero. Reconstructed from saved per-case scalar statistics; no inference.
